title: PSX Character Library: $24.99 for new buyers from 7 December
bodyHtml:
The PSX Character Library goes from $19.99 to $24.99 for new buyers on 7 December 2026. If you already own it, nothing changes: you keep every pack that joins, at no extra cost.

Why now: since 13 November this page has said the price rises by $5 for new buyers each time three more packs join, counted from 16 packs. Eight Angles joined as pack number 19, so this is the first step. Until 7 December 2026 the price stays $19.99.

What the Library holds today: 19 packs, 265 rigged PSX characters and 808 skinned entities, $85.90 if bought one by one across their 10 pages, plus every pack we release after this. The next step is $29.99 at 22 packs, announced here with its own date at least five days ahead. $29.99 is the ceiling.

Want to try the rig, the clips and the shader first? One character from every pack is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Questions go in the comments on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

step.why: Ops/Social/sales_calendar.json read 2026-11-16: Black Friday expected 2026-11-25 18:00Z to 2026-12-03 18:00Z (2024's ran to 12-05); Winter expected 2026-12-17 18:00Z, so its seven-day window opens 2026-12-10 18:00Z. 2026-12-07 is after every precedent end and outside that window; 21 days after the announcement.
